csv_scope_of_work: Kitsap Transit is issuing this Request for Qualifications ("RFQ") to solicit proposals from interested, qualified, and experienced firms to provide construction management services for the installation of sixteen inductive charging units at four locations, including one maintenance base and three transit centers. The work includes the installation of inductive charging pads, charging cabinets, switchgears, demolition of existing concrete, excavation, groundwork, paving, grading, striping, utility upgrades, and other associated tasking. Utility upgrades will include the installation of transformers and high voltage wiring.
